subject: Order Form: legacy usage bands & Exhibit re-segmentation — redline coordination
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@novaprod.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Shah <rajiv.shah@novaprod.com>, contracts@novaprod.com
Date: 2026-04-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form negotiation — exhibit segmentation and legacy bands

Jordan —

Thanks for the call this morning. Attached is our annotated redline of the Order Form and Exhibit A. Two priority items for legal/procurement before we can route to our CFO:

1) Legacy usage bands: we still see a floor that references "legacy bands" in Exhibit A (section 2.1). NovaProd needs explicit language so that historical usage is grandfathered for 12 months after the effective date, otherwise our finance team is exposing forecast variance.

2) Exhibit re-segmentation: we asked to split the implementation SOW into Exhibit B1 (onboarding) and Exhibit B2 (integration support). This affects the implementation milestone schedule and may change the timing for acceptance-based billing.

We also captured some clean-up comments on the billing cadence and a proposed PR clause (subscription termination rights tied to material SLA misses). See attachment: 20260419_NovaProd_Redlines_annotated.docx. Can you confirm which of the redlines are commercial (pricing/milestone) vs legal? We want to keep procurement in the loop but avoid bouncing the doc back and forth between legal and product too many times.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — our target for routing is next Wednesday.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Sr. Counsel, NovaProd

--
Attachment: 20260419_NovaProd_Redlines_annotated.docx (annotated doc, 14 comments)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@novaprod.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-19T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form negotiation — exhibit segmentation and legacy bands

Lena —

Thanks for sending. I reviewed the annotated doc quickly with Naomi and Markus. High-level:

- Legacy bands: commercial ask (pricing/floor) — Naomi can confirm impact to the tiered-rate schedule and whether we can grant a 12-month grandfathering clause without changing the committed volumes.
- Exhibit split (B1/B2): product/implementation scope question (Markus to confirm if the integration support work should be timeboxed as a separate exhibit).
- SLA-triggered termination: legal question — we should propose a remediation/cure period rather than immediate termination.

Plan: Naomi will run the pricing impact and propose revised Exhibit A language. Markus will sketch an Exhibit B1/B2 appendix and revised milestone table. I (Jordan) will consolidate and send a single marked-up change order (PDF) for your review by EOD tomorrow so procurement has something to route.

Are there any absolute non-starters from NovaProd (e.g., acceptance milestones that must remain tied to billing)? If so we should flag now.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-19T13:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form negotiation — exhibit segmentation and legacy bands

Jordan / Markus —

I ran the numbers on the proposed 12-month grandfather for historic usage bands. Short answer: we can offer it with two guardrails: 1) grandfather applies only to usage within the first billing year equal to 110% of the rolling 6-month historical average; 2) any incremental usage beyond grandfathered volume will bill at the next tier's rate (no retroactive discounts).

Implication: this preserves our expected unit economics while giving NovaProd the predictability they asked for. I'll draft the exact clause: "Grandfathering of historical usage: For a period of twelve (12) months following the Effective Date, Customer's usage that does not exceed 110% of the Customer’s rolling six (6) month historical average shall be billed at the rates set forth in Exhibit A (Legacy Bands). Usage above that threshold shall be billed at the tiered rates in Exhibit A without retroactive application of Legacy Bands."

Markus — can you confirm whether splitting into B1/B2 requires any change to the implementation resource plan? If it's purely a re-labeling with the same milestones, we can keep the billing triggers but spell out deliverables per exhibit.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Pricing Programs
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

--

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@novaprod.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-20T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed change order v2 and milestone mapping (EXHIBIT B1/B2)

Lena / Jordan —

Attached is "proposed-change-order-v2.pdf" which consolidates:
- The grandfathering language Naomi proposed (commercial clause inserted into Exhibit A),
- Exhibit B1 (Onboarding): kickoff, dataset handoff, environment provisioning, acceptance testing window (30 days), billing trigger at onboarding acceptance;
- Exhibit B2 (Integration Support): scoping of integrations, weekly sprint support for 12 weeks, milestone-based deliverable list and associated invoicing schedule.

On SLA termination: our legal team recommends a 30-day cure/remediation window and an escalation flow (customer support -> CSM -> engineering review) before termination rights kick in. That is included in Section 7.

Please see inline comments in the PDF. If these changes look good, Jordan — can you confirm whether we should route this to DocuSign for signature or send back as a tracked Word for their legal to redline? My preference: send the consolidated PDF to NovaProd with the option for DocuSign — avoids version drift.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Director, Solutions Architecture
markus.klein@redwood.ai

--
Attachment: proposed-change-order-v2.pdf (consolidated change order, 6 pages)

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@novaprod.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Shah <rajiv.shah@novaprod.com>, contracts@novaprod.com
Date: 2026-04-20T16:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed change order v2 and milestone mapping (EXHIBIT B1/B2)

Markus / Jordan —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Our legal team reviewed the consolidated PDF and we only have two minor asks: 1) soften the wording on the cure period so it's explicit that cure starts from the date of the SLA breach notice (not the calendar day the breach occurred), and 2) minor redline in Exhibit B2 to clarify that "integration scope" excludes third-party connector licensing (NovaProd will procure connectors separately).

Procurement (Rajiv) also confirmed that the grandfathering approach is acceptable if Redwood provides a point-in-time usage report on day 1 of each quarter for the twelve-month period. Can you confirm Redwood can provide that level of reporting? If so, we can accept the change order and route to signature next week.

Lena Ortiz
Sr. Counsel, NovaProd
